mapper.select: SELECT l.store_id, st.code AS store_code, st.name AS store_name, SUM(CASE WHEN l.change_type = 'TOPUP' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS topup_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.change_type = 'TOPUP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS topup_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.change_type = 'BONUS' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bonus_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.change_type = 'CONSUME' THEN -l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS consume_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.change_type = 'REFUND' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS refund_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.change_type = 'ADJUST' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS adjust_amount FROM pos_stored_value_log l JOIN store_info st ON st.id = l.store_id WHERE l.business_date >= #{q.begin} AND l.business_date <= #{q.end} AND l.store_id = #{q.storeId} GROUP BY l.store_id, st.code, st.name ORDER BY st.code
SELECT COALESCE(-SUM(amount), 0) FROM pos_stored_value_log WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND business_date = #{date} AND change_type IN ('CONSUME', 'REFUND')
